author: cens0r3d
install_msg: VoiceSay installed. Use `[p]voicesay <channel|user>` with an audio attachment to send a native voice message.
name: VoiceSay
description: Send attached audio files as native Discord voice messages to text channels or DMs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. Audio attachments are relayed to the destination you choose and are not retained.
